description: Source code for xrsv_http module handling HTTP communication, session management, and message parsing for XR voice SDK.

classes.name: xrsv_http_obj_t
classes.description: Internal structure representing an HTTP session object with identifiers, handlers, query parameters, and user data.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_source_error
methods.description: Handles source error events, invoking user-defined callback.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_connected
methods.description: Handles connection establishment, invoking user-defined callback.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_disconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, invoking user-defined callback.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_session_begin
methods.description: Initializes session parameters and query string attributes at session start.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_session_end
methods.description: Handles session end, invoking user callback and resetting session query parameters.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_stream_begin
methods.description: Handles beginning of a data stream.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_stream_end
methods.description: Handles end of a data stream.

methods.name: xrsv_http_handler_recv_msg
methods.description: Processes received messages, parsing JSON content and invoking user callback.
